_readme: The releases shown on changelog.html, newest first. After editing run: node tools/build-changelog.mjs. 'version' is what the red tag says (a version, or a word such as 'update'); 'title' and 'label' are optional, so is 'short' (a shorter title for the Notes list on the main page, which shows the three newest entries); each item is [kind, text] with kind = added | fixed | changed | removed.
_sources: tzar-hub: its own changelog (src/components/landing/changelog-data.ts), wording kept, the kind of each item chosen here; v1.0.0 = package.json at the first public commit. kimera: summary of the commits of 2026-11-23..24, v0.1.0 = package.json. endfield-il2dump: commit messages and repository description. loliland-modloader: GitHub release v1.0.1 and README.

releases.title: First public version
items: Published on GitHub Pages, with the model and the Mesmerizer dance built into the site.
Eight records, each with its own dance and a stage show in time with the song.
A revolving stage with three sets, stage light and real shadows.
A programme page, posters, a 404 page and a closing curtain.
The pencil-sketch skin draws three times faster.

releases.title: Keyless and open source
releases.label: Cmdr Panel preview
items: No more keys, checkpoints, paid plans or accounts. Every script just runs.
A first look at the Cmdr Panel, still in development: a command bar on ;, key binds, panels and game modules in one place.
The whole hub is readable on the new Source page, file by file.
Old key and pricing links still work and lead to the guide or the home page.

releases.title: Accessories stay on with game rules
releases.label: Avatar Changer
items: Turning on Game rules no longer drops the accessories of the look you wear.

releases.title: Docs and the TZAR Hub name
items: Quick start, a full Avatar Changer guide, executors, FAQ, privacy policy and terms.
The site is now TZAR Hub.
The published Avatar Changer script is leaner, with comments removed.

releases.title: Avatar Changer is out
releases.label: Avatar Changer
items: Wear any player’s avatar by username or any look from the Roblox catalog.
R6 and R15, game rules, saved outfits and a custom emote wheel. Only you see it.

releases.title: Meet Teto
items: An animated Teto helps you find the guide and the community.
The red TZAR look with the flame background.

releases.title: The new TZAR site
items: A fresh site with one loader for every supported game.

releases.title: First version
items: An offline IL2CPP metadata dumper for Unity x64 on Windows: reads GameAssembly.dll and global-metadata.dat from disk, with no injection and no admin rights.

releases.title: First release
items: A Windows loader for a local mod workflow.
